notes:
Fish ESP, and a Visuals tab to drive it.

NEW
- Fish ESP: boxes, names, distance, tracers and off-screen pointers for every roaming fish in the water. Each plate carries the rarity of the bucket it spawned in (Sea Bass - Common), with the rarity tinted to the tier.
- Relic ESP: its own card, its own switch, its own tier filter. Enchant, Exalted, Cosmic, Twisted, Crested and Empyrean keep distinct colours; anything new falls back to the relic swatch.
- Rarity filters are multi-select, so Rare + Relic is one tick list instead of two passes over the water.
- Visuals tab on the rail.

FIXED
- Cast and Reel & shake have master switches in the card head; the card dims when the whole group is off, and the individual switches stay clickable underneath.
- ESP calibration moved to Settings, where the diagnostics belong.
- The overlay no longer eats the mouse. It draws over the game and the camera keeps working.
- The harpoon rarity filter was being written into the fish filter; the two lists are independent now.

UNDER THE HOOD
- The overlay is its own process (BlackPandaOverlay.exe), started by the core and killed with it, so an overlay crash never takes the macro down.
- DirectComposition swap chain: per-pixel alpha composited on the GPU, a steady 60 fps over the game.
- Structure scans run on a worker thread; the render loop only reads a snapshot.
- F8 hides the overlay without touching your saved settings.
